02 / THE APPROACH

From enrolments
to a feasible plan.

Each student's course choices form a conflict graph. Exams connected in that graph should occupy different periods. The optimizer searches this constrained space and repairs candidate schedules before scoring them.

A

Build the conflict graph

For each pair of exams, count how many students take both. That weight measures the cost of placing them at the same time.

B

Move a swarm of candidates

Particles encode a preferred period for every exam. Personal and global bests guide velocity and position updates.

position+ velocity→ new position
C

Repair and compare

A degree-ordered repair step places the most constrained exams first. Fitness prioritizes fewer clashes, then fewer periods and balanced loads.

clashes × 10,000 + periods × 100 + load spread
